item.text: [{"task_id":"ac0c2ac3","source_lines":["def run(params, grid, demos):","    background = int(round(params['geometry'][0]))","    step = int(round(params['geometry'][1]))","    height, width = grid.shape","    rings = {}","    for row, col in np.argwhere(grid != background):","        depth = int(np.minimum(np.minimum(row, col), np.minimum(height - step - row, width - step - col)))","        rings[depth] = int(grid[row, col])","    output = grid.copy()","    for row in range(height):","        for col in range(width):","            depth = int(np.minimum(np.minimum(row, col), np.minimum(height - step - row, width - step - col)))","            output[row, col] = rings.get(depth, background)","    return output"],"shapes":{"geometry":[2]},"params":{"geometry":[7,1]},"rationale":"Each non-background pixel specifies the colour of the concentric square ring at its distance from the nearest grid edge.
